description: Call a Home Assistant service, for example turn a light or switch on or off, or run a script. Returns the entity ids whose state changed.

service_data.description: Extra service data fields, e.g. {"brightness_pct": 50} for a light.

domain.description: Home Assistant domain, e.g. light, switch, script, climate.

service.description: Service within the domain, e.g. turn_on, turn_off, toggle.
